To add a map to your mapping software, the specific steps may vary depending on the software you are using. Here are some general steps that apply to most mapping software:

1. **Determine the map format**: First, confirm the format of the map you want to add. Common formats include KML, KMZ, GPX, GeoJSON, etc.

2. **Open the mapping software**: Launch the mapping software you are using. For example, Google Earth, Google Maps, ArcGIS, QGIS, etc.

3. **Import the map file**:
   - **Google Earth**:
     1. Open Google Earth.
     2. Click on the "File" menu in the upper left corner.
     3. Select "Open" or "Import". 4. Select the map file you want to add (such as a KML or KMZ file).
     5. The file will be loaded into Google Earth, and you can view it in "My Places".

   - **Google Maps**:
     1. Open Google Maps.
     2. Log in to your Google account.
     3. Click on the menu icon (three horizontal lines) in the upper left corner.
     4. Select "My Maps".
     5. Click on "Create a new map". 6. In the new map, click on the "Import" button and select your file for uploading.

   - **ArcGIS**:
     1. Open the ArcGIS software.
     2. Select "Add Data".
     3. Browse and select the map file you want to add.
     4. The file will be loaded into ArcGIS.

   - **QGIS**:
     1. Open QGIS.
     2. Click on the "Layer" menu.
     3. Select "Add Layer".
     4. Select the appropriate option according to the file type (such as "Add Vector Layer").
     5. Browse and select your map file.

4. **Adjust and save**: After importing, you can adjust the display of the map as needed and save the changes.

If you encounter any problems, it is recommended to consult the help documentation or support page of the software you are using for more detailed guidance.

Su Shi and Zhang Jiuling have many other representative poems. Here are some introductions for you:

### Su Shi
- **"Jiangchengzi: Recording a Dream on the Night of the Twentieth Day of the First Month of the Year Yimao"**
    - **Original Text**
    >For ten years, the living and the dead have been worlds apart. Even without thinking, I can't forget. Her solitary grave is a thousand miles away; there's nowhere to pour out my grief. Even if we were to meet, she might not recognize me, my face covered with dust, my temples like frost.
In the quiet dream last night, I suddenly returned to my hometown. By the small window, she was dressing up. Gazing at each other, we were speechless, only tears streaming down our faces. I bet that every year, where my heart breaks, is on the moonlit night, on the hill with short pines.
    - **Appreciation**: This is an elegy written by Su Shi to mourn his first wife, Wang Fu. In the ci-poem, he uses the plain description technique. The words are as ordinary as daily conversations, yet each word is engraved from the bottom of his heart, natural and profound, with sincere feelings embedded in the plainness, showing endless grief and yearning.
- **"Two Poems on Drinking on West Lake, the Second One"**
    - **Original Text**
    >The lake's shimmering in sunshine is truly fine; in misty rain the mountains are captivating too.
Comparing West Lake to Lady Xi Shi is just right; whether lightly or heavily made up, she's always charming.
    - **Appreciation**: While drinking, the poet enjoyed two different views of West Lake - sunny and rainy. So he compared West Lake to the beautiful Xi Shi, highlighting the gentle and natural beauty of West Lake. Comparing the peerless beauty to West Lake not only endows the beauty of West Lake with life but also makes it novel and full of charm.
- **"Dingfengbo: Presented to Yu Niang, the Maid of Wang Dingguo, upon Returning from the South Sea"**
    - **Original Text**
    >I always envy the refined young man in the mortal world; Heaven must have bestowed upon him a fair maid. Everyone says her clear song comes from her white teeth. When the wind blows, snowflakes fly and the scorching sea turns cool.
After traveling thousands of miles, she looks even younger. With a gentle smile, the fragrance of plum blossoms from the mountains lingers when she smiles. I ask if the south of the mountains isn't nice. She replies, 'Wherever my heart finds peace is my hometown.'
    - **Appreciation**: The whole ci-poem uses clear and fluent language to concisely and vividly depict the beautiful character that unifies Rou Nv's appearance and inner self. By praising Rou Nv's valuable character of remaining calm in adversity, the author expresses his open-minded and adaptable state of mind in the political adversity.

### Zhang Jiuling
- **"One of the Twelve Poems on My Feelings, the First One"**
    - **Original Text**
    >Orchid leaves thrive in spring, osmanthus blossoms shine brightly in autumn.
This vibrant vitality makes each season a special time.
Who knows that those living in the forest, upon hearing their fame, come to admire them.
Plants have their own nature; why would they seek to be picked by a beauty!
    - **Appreciation**: This poem compares the poet to spring orchids and autumn osmanthus, expressing his feelings through objects. It shows the poet's self-admiration and his sentiment of not seeking to be known by others. In the first half of the poem, the focus is on praising orchids and osmanthus. In the second half, with the turn of 'Who knows', it leads to the original intention that plants don't seek to be picked by a beauty, hinting at the poet's character and aspirations.
- **"Traveling by Night on the West River"**
    - **Original Text**
    >Where is the person on this long night? I'm traveling in the moonlit clear pool.
The boundless sky stretches far; my deep longing for my hometown stirs.
External things are quiet and undisturbing; in the middle of the stream, I remain serene and pure.
Thinking of returning as the forest leaves change; sitting in sorrow as the dewdrops form.
There are still the cranes on the islet; they suddenly cry out in the middle of the night.
    - **Appreciation**: This poem describes what the poet saw and felt during a night voyage. Through the description of the vast sky, the clear pool, the changing forest leaves, the emerging dewdrops, and the suddenly crying cranes on the islet, it creates a lonely, desolate, and distant atmosphere, profoundly expressing the poet's deep yearning for his hometown.
- **"Viewing the Lushan Waterfall from Hukou"**
    - **Original Text**
    >A ten-thousand-foot red spring cascades down, half hidden in the purple mist in the distance.
Rushing down among the mixed trees, it tumbles out from the clouds and sky.
In the sunlight, it's like a rainbow; on a clear day, the sound is like wind and rain.
The sacred mountain is full of beautiful scenery; the empty water and the mist blend together.
    - **Appreciation**: In the poem, 'ten thousand feet' and 'in the distance' describe the height and the length of the waterfall's water flow, showing the magnificent momentum of the waterfall. 'In the sunlight, it's like a rainbow; on a clear day, the sound is like wind and rain' further exaggerates the grandeur of the waterfall from both visual and auditory angles through the description of the waterfall's colorful appearance like a rainbow in the sunlight and the sound like wind and rain on a clear day. Finally, with the lines 'The sacred mountain is full of beautiful scenery; the empty water and the mist blend together', it integrates the waterfall with the surrounding mountains and waters, giving people a beautiful enjoyment.

Combining three weather conditions: sunny, thunderstorm, and a bit cold, you can choose the following three tourist destinations:

### Brooklyn Bridge
- **Sunny**: Under the sunshine, the architectural details of the Brooklyn Bridge are clearly visible, and the steel structure emits a metallic luster. You can walk or bike across the bridge, enjoy the magnificent views of the Manhattan skyline and the East River to your heart's content. Taking pictures on the bridge is very photogenic, and there are also many street performers around, full of vitality.
- **Thunderstorm**: Take shelter under the bridge during a thunderstorm. Watch the raindrops hit the river surface, forming layers of ripples, and feel the unique atmosphere of New York in the rain. After the rain subsides a bit, you can continue to stroll and enjoy the scenery of the city and the river after being baptized by the rain, which has a special charm.
- **A bit cold**: Even in cold weather, the Brooklyn Bridge has a unique charm. There are relatively fewer pedestrians on the bridge, allowing you to enjoy the snow scenery on both banks or the city scene being blown by the cold wind more quietly, and feel the tenacity and tranquility of New York in cold weather.

### New York Public Library
- **Sunny**: The sun shines through the library windows into the interior, illuminating the exquisite marble architecture and rich collections of books. You can sit in the reading area of the library and enjoy the pleasure of sunshine and reading, or you can sunbathe and read books on the surrounding lawns, enjoying a comfortable time.
- **Thunderstorm**: Thunderstorm weather is suitable for entering the interior of the library. Visit its elegant architectural style, admire the exquisite murals and decorations, and immerse yourself in a strong cultural atmosphere. You can also borrow books or look up information to spend a quiet and fulfilling time.
- **A bit cold**: In cold weather, the library is a warm haven. You can slowly browse various collections of books and participate in cultural activities and lectures held by the library. It can not only keep you warm but also increase your knowledge and cultural qualities.

### Empire State Building
- **Sunny**: During the day, climb to the observation deck of the Empire State Building. Under the sunshine, you can have a panoramic view of the urban scenery of New York, clearly seeing iconic landscapes such as Central Park and the Hudson River. The buildings and streets in the distance look particularly bustling in the sun, and you can take very beautiful panoramic city photos.
- **Thunderstorm**: Watch the rain scene in the indoor area of the observation deck during a thunderstorm. Admire the different appearance of New York City under the cloudy sky, and feel the integration of the power of nature and the city. After the rain stops and the sky clears, you may even see a beautiful rainbow spanning the city sky.
- **A bit cold**: Although the weather is cold, you can still comfortably enjoy the scenery of New York in the indoor part of the observation deck of the Empire State Building, especially at night when the lights are just on and the city is illuminated by lights. It appears even warmer and more romantic in the cold weather, as if you are in a dreamy world.
